title: Domovoy feature group
description: Declarative package of features with dependencies on other groups. A group sits on top of profiles: it may pull whole profiles and single features, and may depend on other groups. The execution order is resolved from the dependency graph and reported honestly.

id.description: Group id in lowercase latin, digits, dots, hyphens.

maxRisk.description: Risk ceiling for the whole resolved package: features with a higher risk are skipped and reported honestly.

items.description: Group id this group depends on. Dependencies are resolved before this group; cycles are rejected.
Profile id whose features are pulled into the package.
Single feature id pulled directly into the package.
